name: TAURUS
question: What are the 12-month safety and symptom outcomes of mirabegron compared with tolterodine ER in adults with overactive bladder?

design.population: Adults with overactive bladder symptoms for at least 3 months, at least eight daily micturitions, and at least three urgency episodes in a 3-day diary.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, active-controlled randomized safety trial
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Design and Interventions; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00688688, Participant Flow

verdictNote: The abstract reports adverse-event rates without a formal comparative safety threshold.
takeaway: Over 12 months, mirabegron 50 mg and 100 mg had treatment-emergent adverse-event rates of 59.7% and 61.3%, versus 62.6% with tolterodine ER 4 mg; dry mouth was less frequent with mirabegron.

reports.label: 12-month safety and efficacy
reports.citation: Chapple CR, Kaplan SA, Mitcheson D, et al. "Randomized Double-blind, Active-controlled Phase 3 Study to Assess 12-Month Safety and Efficacy of Mirabegron, a β3-Adrenoceptor Agonist, in Overactive Bladder." *Eur Urol.* 2013;63(2):296-305. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2012.10.048

results.measure: Patients with at least one treatment-emergent adverse event over 12 months
results.note: Incidence and severity were the primary safety variable; no prespecified comparative threshold is reported in the abstract.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Outcome Measurements and Results

results.measure: Adjusted mean change from baseline to final visit, mm Hg
results.note: Final-visit adjusted changes; between-arm estimates are not reported in the abstract.

results.measure: Change in key symptoms from first measured visit at 4 weeks through 12 months
results.note: The abstract does not give numeric symptom changes or between-arm estimates.

delivery.label: Run-in and assigned treatment
delivery.value: Two-week single-blind placebo run-in, then once-daily double-blind assigned drug for 12 months.

relations.note: Some entrants previously completed SCORPIO; TAURUS assessed safety during a new 12-month treatment course.
Some entrants previously completed ARIES; TAURUS assessed safety during a new 12-month treatment course.
